businesses.booking: The course page links to the public school-branded form. It accepts grade, discipline, Sofia branch and group format and describes a non-binding request with a callback. No sign-in, student data, slot, request or real enrolment tested. The terms require a registration form, an individual contract and payment before enrolment is complete. The call number is the existing public school-wide number, not claimed as a dedicated branch or class schedule.
businesses.tariff: Either sixth-grade subject costs three equal instalments of EUR 390, payable on enrolment, at the end of November and in February. This is the rate of one required instalment, not one visit, a deposit, a discount or the whole-course total. Each subject has 120 academic units over the year (September–June). The branch lists both subjects on Saturday or Sunday; the school confirms group/availability. Absences do not reduce the fee. Combined plans, promotions and grade-7 tariffs with inconsistent published academic-hour totals were left out.
businesses.termsScope: Owner robots returns a blank Disallow. Owner terms concern courses, enrolment, cancellation/refunds and personal data; no express commercial factual-inventory reuse denial found in the current public terms. No source text, photos, reviews or map payload were imported. No licence claim.
